steps.action: Attempt to export the transmissible package (placeholder ID)
steps.what_the_user_sees: Export is BLOCKED (HTTP 409 — 'validation_not_passed'). To proceed you must resolve the findings (set the real Dossier ID), or export with an explicit, reasoned, audited override.
